answer: Base influence on rotating route-reliability trials. Each identity locks 40 POA and operates five randomly assigned delivery paths per epoch for 14 epochs. A voyage beacon hides destinations until commitment; six of nine auditors verify signed arrival traces. A plume digest merges copied routes into one credit, while a gale test injects two random outages. N aliases need 5N independent routes and lock 40N POA; two missed deliveries burn each bond.
